items.title: Stale PTON_WALLET_CODE_v2 / PTON_MINTER_CODE_v2 cause deployWallet to bounce (exit 9)
items.body: The pTON v2 code cells hardcoded in libs/src/wrappers/PTon.ts are out of sync with the current build in ston-fi/pton-contracts. Deploying a pTON v2 minter/wallet using these defaults and calling deployWallet bounces with exit code 9. Affected constants: PTON_MINTER_CODE_v2 and PTON_WALLET_CODE_v2.

relevance: unrelated OOS PTON wrapper deployment issue; not evidence for BA4
